trigger.title: users see errors on the shop

symptoms_summary: Users see 500 errors on the shop: frontend 5xx rate is 14.3% (threshold 5%), frontend error ratio 21% vs 9.5% baseline, and checkout error ratio is 100%. All failing requests are cart-related (GET /api/cart, AddItem) failing with gRPC status 14 UNAVAILABLE (EHOSTUNREACH to cart:7070).

root_cause.cause: The cart container exited (exit code 0, no OOM) about 18 minutes ago and was never restarted, so all gRPC calls from frontend and checkout to cart:7070 fail with UNAVAILABLE/EHOSTUNREACH, surfacing as 500s to users.

confidence_notes: 5 of 6 evidence items were not found in tool outputs and were dropped

evidence.detail: Trace shows the exact failure: connection to cart host unreachable, propagating as 500 up the chain.
evidence.reference: 14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: Error: connect EHOSTUNREACH 172.18.0.21:7070

unverified_evidence_dropped.detail: Detector reports the cart container is stopped, matching the alert time window.
Container state confirms cart is exited, not OOM-killed, no restarts.
unverified_evidence_dropped.reference: state: exited, exit_code: 0, oom_killed: false, restart_count: 0, finished_at: 2026-10-23T11:46:54.43034233Z

unverified_evidence_dropped.detail: Errors originate in frontend's gRPC calls to cart with status 14 (UNAVAILABLE).
Frontend logs show continuous API failures during the incident.
Frontend 5xx rate 14.3% vs 5% threshold; checkout error ratio 1.0 (also depends on cart).

alternatives_ruled_out: Resource exhaustion: cart was not OOM-killed (oom_killed: false) and exited with code 0
Code regression/deploy: no recent restarts of cart or other services in deploy history; all other services healthy with 0% errors
Latency issue: p95 latencies are at or below baseline; failures are hard errors, not slowness
Network-wide issue: only cart:7070 is unreachable; all other services (product-catalog, currency, recommendation, ad) are healthy

recommended_action.reason: Confidence 0.16 is below 0.6. Proposed fix kept for the human: restart_service cart

proposed_fix.reason: The cart container exited cleanly (exit code 0, no OOM) and was never restarted; restarting it will restore cart:7070 and clear the UNAVAILABLE errors in frontend and checkout.

prevention: Add a container liveness/orchestration policy (e.g. Docker restart=always or a k8s liveness probe) so the cart container is automatically restarted if it exits, and alert on container exit events rather than waiting for user-facing 5xx rates to breach.
safety_note: Diagnosis only: read-only tools, no feature-flag access, no changes made. Any action requires human approval and goes through the Action API (Hands).
